card.name: Conditional words in overdose instructions
card.fires_on: The words "if" and "until" that open a clause in opioid overdose instructions, such as after "even" or after "monitor the patient".

modes.label: even if
modes.description: The word "if" after "even" in advice to call 911 when an overdose reversal agent is given.
modes.example: Emphasize the importance of calling 911 or getting emergency medical help, even<< if>> an opioid overdose reversal agent is administered.

modes.label: until recovery
modes.description: The word "until" after a monitoring instruction in overdose management text.
modes.example: close medical supervision and monitoring should continue<< until>> the patient recovers.
